crossRefs.note: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break…
For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs…
They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous…
For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the destroyers have destroyed them, and…

translations.web: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
translations.bsb: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
translations.kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck
